title: Nomi Nomi no Mi
structure: 3 abilities + Punk Records as the peak (no stages and no awakening)
facts: Appearance: not revealed (plain swirl fruit stands in)
Paramecia, Brain-Brain Fruit: the user's brain grows to store endless knowledge, retaining everything learned
The brain grows as knowledge accumulates; Vegapunk's head became enormous
He detached most of his brain: Punk Records, a still-growing brain that linked people can access
His six satellites share Punk Records (revealed around chapter 1067)

plan.fruit: The fruit's appearance **has never been revealed**, so a plain round swirl fruit in pink stands in (no face or limbs).
cast: **Enemy (new, original):** a know-it-all rival student with red hair and a purple sweater vest.
**Dr. Vegapunk:** an old scientist with white hair, moustache and beard, a lab coat and a headset with a glowing antenna. Send a reference to match him exactly.
**The six satellites:** six coloured figures in pods (no detailed designs).
plan.sets: library, indigo rays, towers of books, planetarium, circuit-board wall, classroom with a chalkboard, corridor of doors, lab with glowing tubes, sky full of data cables, hallway with a tiny door, glowing vat lab, room of six pods, exam hall.
